description: Complete floor plan implementation for visualizing and managing restaurant table layouts with real-time status updates

utilities.useMediaQuery: Custom hook for responsive media queries
utilities.formatMinutesLabel: Formats total minutes to localized time label
utilities.normalizePosition: Normalizes position object with x, y, rotation

features: Table status visualization with color coding
Table inspector panel (desktop sidebar / mobile sheet)
Merged table group visualization with connecting lines
Add booking and browse bookings actions

features: Automatic polling every 10 seconds when realtime is disabled
Supabase realtime subscriptions for allocations and table_holds tables

features: Fetches assignment context for a specific booking

fields.name: string | null
fields.position: { x: number; y: number; rotation: number } | null

dataFlow: 1. FloorPlanPage fetches operating hours, zones, and tables via React Query
2. useOpsTableTimeline fetches real-time table status timeline
3. Tables are positioned using normalized coordinates (0-100%)
4. Status is determined by finding segment at current timestamp
5. Real-time updates via Supabase postgres_changes subscriptions

stateManagement.currentTimeVal: Selected time in minutes from midnight

featureFlags.NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_REALTIME_FLOORPLAN: Enables real-time Supabase subscriptions for floor plan updates
